about: Jawhart Al Bakheet Motors specialized in supplying new vehicles to the Iraqi market and the Middle East area through its extensive network of branches and showrooms that are specifically designed to offer a good relaxing atmosphere within the sales process.
Jawhart Al Bakheet Motors was founded in 1997, owned and operated by Mr. Fadel Al shammary, Mr. Khalid Al shammary, Mr. Shehab Al shammary, and Mr. Abed al rahman Al shammary.
